events.title: Hello, this is Myosotis from the DeVILSTOPIA development team.
events.summary: Hello, we are Myosotis, the development team behind DeVILSTOPIA.First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude for playing our demo and showing interest in our game. We are dedicated to creating a more polished and complete experience based on your valuable feedback.If you encounter any inconveniences or have suggestions for improvement during your play, please feel free to reach out to us through the following channels:QR Code (Google Form): Available on the Game Over/Clear screen
